title: Grateful Dead Live at Great American Music Hall on 1975-08-13
lineage: Burned direct to CD from Cassette using a ~1989 TC-WE475 Stereo Cassette Deck  to a ~2001 Sony CD Burner. Converted raw wav files to 14Hkbps / 44khz using Roxio import Cd function of Roxio Music Creator suite (2009). Pitch Corrected by -1% using Adobe Audtion CC 2018. Tracking, editing and patching using Roxio Sound Editor (2009).

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear FM broadcast capture delivers excellent sound quality while the hiatus‑era show shines with top‑notch performances of Blues for Allah material and a standout Franklin's Tower.
ai_review.review: The recording is an FM‑broadcast mix that retains a bright, colorful tone and sounds great on hi‑fi gear. Reviewers rave about the rehearsed, high‑energy performance – especially the rendition of Franklin’s Tower and the showcase of the new Blues for Allah material. Minor complaints are limited to a mislabeled track listing.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance praised by two detailed reviews and very good FM broadcast sound quality; only one brief negative comment about track labeling.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Monitored two‑channel stereo feed recorded for FM broadcast; clear, crisp with a pleasant coloration not present on the commercial remaster. No tape loops or major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rehearsed, cohesive set that served as a showcase for the new Blues for Allah LP during the post‑1974 hiatus, with smooth transitions and high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart adds distinctive cricket‑in‑a‑box sound effects, enhancing the texture of the performance.
